card.name: Linking words just before death
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verb forms such as "to", "of", "resulting" that come right before an expected word like death, mortality or fatal. Seen in warnings about outcomes of liver failure, overdose or infection.

modes.label: Lead to / result in
modes.description: The word "to" or "resulting" after "lead" or "at times", just before a severe outcome ending in death.
modes.example: which can lead<< to>> overdose and death, assess each patient’s

modes.label: Risk of mortality
modes.description: The word "of" after "risk" where mortality is expected next.
modes.example: increases the risk<< of>> drug-related mortality compared to use of opioid

modes.label: Fatal outcome setup
modes.description: A punctuation mark or noun that sets up a fatal or deadly description.
modes.example: Serious<<,>> life-threatening, or fatal respiratory depression has
